caseName: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp. v. Yahn & McDonnell, Inc.
caseNameFull: PENSION BENEFIT GUARANTY CORPORATION v. YAHN & McDONNELL, INC.
attorneys: Gary M. Ford argued the cause for appellants in both cases. With him on the briefs for appellant in No. 86-231 were Peter H. Gould, David F. Power, Kenneth S. Getter, Kathryn A. Oberly, and Mitchell L. Strickler. Richard H. Markowitz and Paula R. Markowitz filed briefs for appellants in No. 86-253., Carl L. Taylor argued the cause for appellees in both cases. With him on the brief were Glenn Summers and William H. Ewing. †

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Justice White took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.
